msrframe · trainable MSR neutronics design framework

EVOL MSFR design framework (trainable)

Generated 2026-11-04 03:57. Every stage's methods are plug-ins chosen in the YAML config; all numbers come from the data files listed there.

Overview

476screening runs
61 inputs -> 9 kept
200k_eff runs
best: gp (278 pcm)
60burnup histories
best: pca:gp
3scenarios optimised
feasible, mean inside band

Stage 1 - Parameter screening

3 screening methods (morris, sobol_pce, active_subspace) were applied to 476 runs over 61 inputs. They retain 9, 7, 6 inputs respectively (lowest pairwise Jaccard agreement 0.67). Consensus (2+ votes plus safety-forced inputs) keeps 9 inputs: u238_pct, uf4_molpct, hn_molpct, u234_pct, li7_enrich, u236_pct, core_radius, fuel_inlet_T, fuel_density_mult. A GP on this set reaches 661 pcm CV RMSE (R2 = 0.9936). Lowest retention-curve error: sobol_pce.

Stage 2 - k_eff predictor

Best k_eff surrogate on 200 runs: gp with 278 pcm cross-validated RMSE (R2 = 0.99836, 95% interval coverage 94%). The Monte Carlo noise of the targets is 197 pcm rms, so part of every error is OpenMC noise. Worst: random_forest (2547 pcm). Learning curves show the error of gp falling from 408 to 262 pcm as training data grow - adding OpenMC runs keeps improving it.

Stage 3 - Burnup predictor

Best burnup surrogate over 60 histories: pca:gp with 488 pcm k_eff RMSE in 5-fold CV; U233_fuel_kg 0.32%, fissile_total_kg 0.36%, Pa233_fuel_kg 0.26%, FP_fuel_kg 12.25%, Lan_fuel_kg 5.50%, HN_molpct 0.07%, Th232_fuel_kg 0.08%. Ranking: pca:gp > pca:dnn > time_input:gbt > pca:random_forest. Add depletion histories to data/user/ to tighten it.

Stage 4 - Fuel-cycle optimiser

Hold critical for 18 years with EVOL lanthanide processing: feasible (RMS deviation 94 pcm, best optimiser nelder_mead). Same plan with lanthanide processing unavailable: mean inside band, not certified at 1.0 sigma (RMS deviation 102 pcm, best optimiser differential_evolution). Extract as much bred 233U as criticality allows (30 years): mean inside band, not certified at 1.0 sigma (RMS deviation 136 pcm, best optimiser nelder_mead). Controls are exported to verify_in_openmc.csv for transport verification.
